definitions.explanation: Oriented toward the south, especially of rooms, buildings, or windows, which receive the most sunlight in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{南向|みなみむ}きだ。
{南向|みなみむ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。

{南向|みなみむ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{日差|ひざ}し→日差し：00107_hizashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{暖|あたた}かい→暖かい：00618_atatakai⟧。
examples.english: Plenty of sunlight comes through the south-facing window, so it's warm even in winter.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧ (south) and ⟦{向|む}き→向き：12041_muki⟧ (facing, orientation). In Japanese real estate, {南向|みなみむ}き is highly valued because south-facing rooms get the most sunlight throughout the day. It is one of the most important criteria when choosing an apartment or house in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {南向|みなみむ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: south-facing room
- {南向|みなみむ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧: south-facing window
- {南向|みなみむ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物件|ぶっけん}→物件：06743_bukken⟧: south-facing property
- {南向|みなみむ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バルコニー→バルコニー：06772_barukonii⟧: south-facing balcony

- {北向|きたむ}き: north-facing — least desirable for sunlight
- {東向|ひがしむ}き: east-facing — gets morning sun
- {西向|にしむ}き: west-facing — gets afternoon sun
